plans.objective: Design the existing Veyra Next.js pages using shadcn/ui components and the design.md premium editorial marketplace direction, while keeping writer ownership non-overlapping and preserving existing API/data behavior.

tasks.description: Install shadcn and create design foundation
tasks.prompt:
Implement the shared visual foundation for the Veyra web app.

Read first:
- /Users/avinash/code/assignments/Veyra/design.md
- /Users/avinash/code/assignments/Veyra/docs/progress-tracker.md
- /Users/avinash/code/assignments/Veyra/apps/web/AGENTS.md
- Relevant Next 16 docs under apps/web/node_modules/next/dist/docs before editing Next files.

Scope and ownership:
- You MAY edit: apps/web/package.json, root lockfile if CLI changes it, apps/web/components.json if created, apps/web/src/app/globals.css, apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx, apps/web/src/lib/**, apps/web/src/components/**, apps/web/src/app/components/**.
- You MUST NOT edit route page files except layout.tsx.

Requirements:
- Use official current shadcn CLI commands verified by Atlas: `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest init` then `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add button card badge input select sheet dialog tabs accordion table separator skeleton` as needed. Use pnpm.
- If shadcn init prompts, choose defaults suitable for this Next app and Tailwind setup; do not introduce unnecessary dependencies beyond what shadcn requires.
- Establish a premium warm editorial marketplace theme from design.md: warm paper, deep ink, muted accessible text, refined accent, full-card borders, visible focus, reduced-motion aware transitions. Avoid default AI-blue and Amazon clone styling.
- Prefer shadcn component source as the base, then enhance via tokens/classes without killing the shadcn premium feel.
- Create reusable marketplace presentation components/helpers for page agents to consume, such as app shell/header/footer, section shell, product card, state panel, guidance/evidence panel, totals card, timeline list, and form/search primitives if practical.
- Preserve semantic accessibility, skip link, legal/footer links, metadata language en-IN, and simulation disclosure tone.
- No `any`, no placeholders, no fake unavailable behavior.

Done when:
- shadcn component files exist and compile syntactically.
- Shared components are exported and documented by their TypeScript names in your final output.
- `pnpm --filter @veyra/web lint` and `pnpm --filter @veyra/web build` are attempted after your edits if feasible; report exact result.
